result.summary: Several visual bugs: truncated restaurant names, a nonsensical '-100%' badge, cut-off category chips, and partial cards at the edges indicate layout/overflow problems.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a white badge reading '-100%', which is confusing and likely a broken discount/percentage display.
issues.suggestion: Correct the badge to a valid promo (e.g. '-10%' or '50% off') or hide it when the value is invalid.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the Fastest near you row, so the full name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping to two lines, reduce font size, or ensure the horizontal card width fits the full name with proper ellipsis only when necessary.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow the screen; a partial chip is visible on the right with no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add fade/scroll hint or ensure chips fit, and keep adequate end padding so the last chip isn’t clipped awkwardly.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is heavily clipped at the right edge, making the row look broken.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal list padding and card widths so peeks of the next card are intentional and consistent, not cut mid-content.

issues.description: Bottom pizza card is cut off mid-image above the tab bar, so the section feels incomplete on load.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding so cards aren’t obscured by the tab bar and users can see a clean card boundary.
